articles.title: NYSE owner ICE taps tZERO for tokenized securities push, takes stake in firm
articles.snippet: The deal adds transfer-agent and settlement infrastructure to ICE's plans for an NYSE-affiliated market for tokenized stocks, tZERO said.

articles.title: Japanese regulator requests tax filing exemption for trust-type stablecoins in 2027 reform
articles.snippet: Japan’s FSA requested to exempt trust-type stablecoins from mandatory tax filings starting in fiscal year 2027, arguing that it would improve their use as transaction tools.
